purpose: Durable anchors from LYVRA current self to deep historical memory and provenance.
authority_rule: Historical sources inform provenance and re-evaluation but do not silently override repository current state.

sources.read_rule: Full read when material; snippets are never authority/readback.

migration_requirement: All critical current LYVRA knowledge must be represented in the repository before deep historical sources can be treated as provenance-only for normal rehydration.
